journal_lines: Paused at a moss-covered stone. Strange marks. Sat with it a long while before moving on.
Inscription on the rock face. Old enough that the stone had grown into it. Stayed and looked.
Found it in a clearing. Marks cut deep. Something meaningful about them. Rested here.
Carving on the stone older than any wolf, possibly older than wolves. Sat with it.
The marks meant something. Could not say what. Did not need to.
Lichen had grown around the letters, leaving them clear, almost on purpose.
A circle of stones around the inscription. Sat in the circle. Felt rested afterward, oddly.
Did not understand the words. Understood the wanting them written. That was enough.
